synopsis.native: Žak, mlad fant, se po smrti svojih staršev odpravi na jadrnico v iskanju miru in spominov, a pot mu prekriža Lučka, pretirano zgovorna punca, ki se mu prilepi za hrbet in mu sledi vse do jadrnice v marini. Prepriča ga, da jo vzame s sabo na krov in na jadranju po Jadranu se izkaže, da sta drug drugemu najboljše zdravilo za usode, ki jih prestajata.
synopsis.english: In the bunny school, the the appointment of the new "master bunnies" by the magical golden egg is happening. After selecting Max, a city bunny, as the champion bunny candidate, the golden egg suddenly turns black.
